rationale: The long thesis is intact — price is pinned on a persistent one-cent bid at $31.89 above VWAP ($31.82) and the 9-EMA, the lone dip to $31.87 was bought back immediately, and the probe to $31.93 marked a fresh high-of-day, so the original $31.70 invalidation remains untouched. The rejected 31.93 push and eight minutes of sideways tape with near-zero P&L cap conviction, but defined risk of ~$68 to invalidation is well inside the remaining $222.85 loss budget and there is no mechanical evidence of distribution to justify closing, and nothing close to the stronger evidence a flip short would require against a stock still holding above rising VWAP.
